## Details

<a id="fuel_burn"></a>
### [`fuel_burn`](../../../../src/player/fuel.asm#L6) `$5540`

*routine*

Burns fuel when jet_state bits 1, 3, 7 are 0: on even ticks at speed +-3, else every 8th tick. Sets jet_state bit 7 at GAS 000, bit 6 below 100.

- **Called from:** [`$41A2`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L66)
- **Reads:** [`jet_state`](../../memory-map.md#jet_state), [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`jet_speed_x`](../../memory-map.md#jet_speed_x), [`gas_count`](../../memory-map.md#gas_count)
- **Writes:** [`gas_count`](../../memory-map.md#gas_count), [`jet_state`](../../memory-map.md#jet_state)

| Label | Address | Comment |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fuel_burn_decrement"></a>[`fuel_burn_decrement`](../../../../src/player/fuel.asm#L21) | `$555C` | Decimal subtract: $19 ones, $18 tens, $17 hundreds. |
| <a id="fuel_burn_check_level"></a>[`fuel_burn_check_level`](../../../../src/player/fuel.asm#L33) | `$5570` | Clears bits 6 and 7, then sets them again from the GAS digits. |
